edition.authority: Sacred Congregation of Rites; Archdiocese of New York
edition.notes: A publisher-produced edition distinct from the Vatican editio typica. The scanned title and imprint identify Benziger Brothers, Inc., New York, and the approval leaf states that the Sacred Congregation of Rites had approved the Benziger edition and declared it iuxta typicam on 21 October 1961; Francis Cardinal Spellman approved this first edition and licensed its publication in New York in 1962.

work.author: Catholic Church
work.description: The Roman Rite altar book containing the Order of Mass, the temporal and sanctoral cycles, Commons, votive and Requiem Masses, and related rubrical and ritual material. Edition records distinguish the authoritative typical edition from publisher-produced editions made according to it.
